title: 🏆 Test Practice 1
source: NIES Grade 3 Block 2 English Test (scanned test A: Basketball)

activities.title: Classify the Words
activities.prompt: Catch each word and send it to its family!

activities.title: Read and Match
activities.prompt: Match each description with its picture idea.
pairs: Yesterday, I went with my brother to the club. We played football with our friends and had so much fun.
Singing is my secret talent. I have been practicing singing for 5 years, and my friends don't know anything about it.
Samy and John had a bad fight last Saturday. Luckily, they forgave each other today, which makes me really happy.
Salma's favourite food is chicken fillet. One day, she invited me over and made it for me. It was tasty.
Everyday, my sister calls her friends for a long time, but she makes sure to finish her homework before she calls them.

scenes.t: You play basketball with a big orange ball.
There are two teams with 5 players.
Both teams try to get points by throwing the ball into a basket, which is three meters above the floor.
You can throw, run and bounce the ball, but you can't run and carry the ball at the same time.
The winning team is the team with more points after 40 minutes.

items.q: How many players are there in a basketball team?
Can you run and carry the ball at the same time?
How do you get points in basketball?
o: By throwing the ball into a basket

items.q: What does the ball look like?
How many minutes do you play?
How do we know the winner?
A team sport with a basket and a hoop. (B _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _)
You kick the ball and score goals. (F _ _ _ _ _ _ _)
Put in order: old - man - is - walking - slowly - the
o: The old man is walking slowly.
The old man walking is slowly.
Slowly the old man is walking.

items.q: Put in order: where - does - Anna - homework - do - her
o: Where does Anna do her homework?
Where Anna does do her homework?
Where does homework Anna do her?

items.q: Put in order: cousins - who - play - have - tennis - I
o: I have cousins who play tennis.
I have who cousins play tennis.
Cousins I have who play tennis.

items.q: Put in order: is - the - where - place - we - sail - where
o: Where is the place where we sail?
Where the place is where we sail?
Where is we sail the place where?

items.q: Put in order: plays - tennis - in - activity - she - the - centre
o: She plays tennis in the activity centre.
She plays in the activity centre tennis.
Tennis she plays in the activity centre.
